import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int mod = 1000000007;
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int p = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();

        if (k == 0) {
            System.out.println(powMod(p, p - 1, mod));
        } else if (k == 1) {
            System.out.println(powMod(p, p, mod));
        } else {
            int[] z = {1};
            boolean foundCycle = false;
            while (!foundCycle) {
                int next = (int)((long)z[z.length - 1] * k % p);
                // Check if the cycle is complete
                if (next == z[0]) {
                    foundCycle = true;
                } else {
                    int[] newZ = new int[z.length + 1];
                    System.arraycopy(z, 0, newZ, 0, z.length);
                    newZ[z.length] = next;
                    z = newZ;
                }
            }
            int lenZ = z.length;
            System.out.println(powMod(p, (p - 1) / lenZ, mod));
        }
        sc.close();
    }

    private static long powMod(long base, long exp, int mod) {
        long result = 1;
        long b = base % mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * b) % mod;
            }
            b = (b * b) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
